The soft_asset_share positions match the calculator: "third highest of the 6 filled quarters" now and "highest of the 6 filled quarters" at quarters-back-1. The Basler purchase-accounting and goodwill items show acquired goodwill and intangibles arriving in the same window.

The soft-asset, liabilities_over_assets and equity_multiplier paths exist. The headroom item puts Industrial Controls at the bottom of the reporting-unit range at the test date, and the goodwill roll-forward shows the Basler adjustment.

Both trailing growth paths are negative, while the year-over-year paths and ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters are positive. The smoothness net_income series puts the latest fiscal fourth-quarter loss in the current window only.

The foreign-exchange swing (8k_2_02:53) and the lower tax rate (notes:167) are real. But the cited Polytronics item itself reads "Other non-operating income is 2919000 in the quarter against 4452000.", so the gain did not widen the gap, and notes:167 never calls the tax items discrete.

coverage.why: Every accounting area, industry_lens included, holds only a gate drop. In the financial analysis the liquidity, solvency and dupont readings were dropped; only profitability, efficiency, growth, free_cash_flow and path_to_distress were answered.

calibration.why: No accounting area has a surviving verdict to compare with the anomalies filed under it. The liquidity and solvency sections have anomalies but no reading, and summary_ko for controls_audit_and_filing_signals describes findings whose anomalies were dropped.

valuation_reading.why: value_range, price_position and market_implied_growth were dropped and most_sensitive is empty. calculator.json valuation.reverse_dcf and valuation.sensitivity both read "no base scenario", and the summary infers the sensitive drivers from the inputs rather than reading them from the calculator.
